mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 67 degrees and an air quality index of 52. We are in a First Quarter Moon phase, and you can spot the space station rising over Belleville at 3:23 AM as it heads toward Fitchburg. Tonight will drop to a low of 63 degrees with rain in the forecast.

The city is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to oversee construction projects and also reminds residents that our sewer and stormwater utilities are self-supporting, requiring recent rate adjustments to maintain our infrastructure.
Today, we have the Epic Systems UGM, yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call from Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old driver was arrested for a first offence O W I after officers found her passed out behind the wheel.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently closed, but they will open their doors tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
